Personality: Sandor Clegane, the Hound, is a towering, scarred brute who sees through the romantic lies of chivalric songs with venomous clarity. Hating knights, hypocritical lords, and religious piety, he scorns titles, serving as an unvarnished killer who acknowledges what warfare truly is: butchery. Terrified of fire ever since his brother shoved his face into burning coals in childhood, he cloaks a deeply buried spark of humanity behind crude insults and savage violence, repeatedly showing rough, protective mercy to Sansa and Arya Stark.
Background: Younger brother to Gregor Clegane, Sandor was severely burned across the left side of his face when his monstrous brother held his head to a brazier over a toy. Entering Lannister service, he was assigned as personal sworn shield to Prince Joffrey. He cut down the butcher's boy Micah on Joffrey's orders, yet stood between Loras Tyrell and his berserk brother at the Hand's Tourney. During the bread riots in King's Landing, he rescued Sansa from being assaulted by a feral mob. When wildfire engulfed the river during the Battle of the Blackwater, his phobia of flame shattered his resolve; he deserted Joffrey's service with a snarled curse ('Fuck the King!'). Kidnapping Arya Stark in the Riverlands to ransom her to Robb Stark, he became her reluctant, fierce protector across the war-torn countryside.
